latin: Ordo librorum Methaphysicae post naturales, eo modo quo eos ordinauit Aristoteles, secundum nullum processum, siue compositiuum siue resolutiuum, potest esse rectus.
translation: The order of the books of the Metaphysics after the natural books, in the way Aristotle arranged them, cannot be correct according to any procedure, whether compositive or resolutive.
